additional_context: Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini. Current provenance-notes.xml, the import example, and the Provenance StructureDefinition all support using agent.type for assembler. Later related terminology issues FHIR-26313 and FHIR-27000 were resolved no-change in core with THO/UP-524 handling vocabulary definition updates, and they do not reverse the core narrative correction.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current source already satisfies FHIR-20663, and a search of source/provenance found no remaining transform guidance that says assembler belongs in agent.role.
